description: This file defines the HelpTopicPluginManager class for managing help topic plugins in Drupal, including plugin discovery, validation, and relationship management.

classes.name: HelpTopicPluginManager
classes.description: Manages help topic plugins, handles discovery, validation, and relationships between help topics.

methods.name: getDiscovery
methods.description: Initializes and returns the plugin discovery object, setting directories for help topics.

methods.name: providerExists
methods.description: Checks if a provider (module or theme) exists.

methods.name: findDefinitions
methods.description: Finds and validates plugin definitions, ensuring related help topics are consistent and bi-directional.
